newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land lowest bid price seen at 8,000 yen.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land lowest bid price seen at 8,000 yen.

text.p: The lowest bid price for Oriental Land Co Ltd's stock auction on Wednesday is expected to be around 8,000 yen, brokers and investors said on Tuesday.
Oriental Land, which operates Tokyo Disneyland, will be listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11.
Oriental Land said earlier this month that the minimum auction offer price for its shares was set at 5,220 yen.
Forecasts for the lowest bid price ranged from 7,000 yen to 8,500 yen.
